title: Amidst The Chaos Live From The Hollywood Bowl
notes: This pressing has a misprint on the track listing, listed on the back cover, LP label, and sleeve. Track C3 is listed as "A Safe Place to Land," (written by Sara Bareilles and Lori McKenna). In actuality, the song is "Soft Place To Land," music & lyrics by Sara Bareilles from the musical "Waitress."
